opening.argument: The video directs viewers to sign up for named investment platforms, then presents purported daily returns and withdrawals as evidence that those platforms work. It claims BitSolid is paying “2.4%” daily and reports withdrawing roughly $60 from a $100 investment, while demonstrating reinvestment of accrued funds. It also connects a $25 deposit to daily payments and describes investing in the Dragon Foundation. The BitConnect account page visibly identifies “BITCONNECT LENDING,” and the presentation includes an interface inviting recruitment of new members. Together, these are concrete promotions of deposits, reinvestment, and referrals tied to potential financial returns.
